description: This file contains abstract test cases for subclasses of {@link org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.pubsub.ddata.AbstractSubscriptions}. It uses the JUnit testing framework and mocks actor references for testing subscription behaviors, such as creation, membership, rotation, removal, and snapshotting of subscriptions.

classes.name: AbstractSubscriptionsTest
classes.description: Abstract JUnit test class for subclasses of AbstractSubscriptions, testing various subscription scenarios using mocked ActorRefs.

methods.name: createEmptySubscriptions
methods.description: Tests that a new subscriptions object is empty.

methods.name: testVennDiagramMembership
methods.description: Verifies correct membership in venn-diagram-like subscriptions.

methods.name: testVennDiagramMembershipAfterRotation
methods.description: Checks subscription memberships after subscribing and unsubscribing in a specific sequence.

methods.name: testVennDiagramMembershipAfterAnotherRotation
methods.description: Verifies membership after multiple subscription and unsubscription operations.

methods.name: testSubscriberRemoval
methods.description: Ensures removing a subscriber removes their subscriptions.

methods.name: testSnapshot
methods.description: Tests the snapshot feature to ensure immutability and consistency.

methods.name: changeDetectionIsAccurate
methods.description: Assesses correct detection of changes in subscription state.
